name: Varlim
source:
Varlim is Hagi's and Cherumi's sister, and third elite member of the Misfits... a title she seized from her sister in an attempt to be closer to her brother, the #1.
She is a wild, fiery girl, whose energetic personality is only rivaled by her equally strong affection towards her siblings. An affection that is pointed out to may be more than just sisterly love by others quite frequently.
Constantly butting heads with the girls surrounding her brother and being obsessed with fighting and collecting armor, Varlim appears somewhat unapproachable at first glance. But deep down, she is quite a gentle and romantic soul.
